query: Of relevance to this issue is our finding that elements of the 7u2 subfamily are highly and exclusively expressed in the pluripotent epiblast in vivo (Figure 5), but weakly so in H1 ESC, which consists of a majority of primed cells and a minority of naïve or formative cells (Gafni et al., 2013).
